other_conditions: Applicant must be the legal nominee or dependent of the deceased worker.
Deceased worker must have been a resident of Meghalaya.
Deceased worker must have been engaged in building or other construction work.
Deceased worker must have been registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,000 is provided to nominees or dependents of deceased registered construction workers for funeral expenses.
